title: The silent-undo refusal prints its Drops-lines remedy as a whole commit message, and the lane lint prints the trailer proof to run after the commit
why: Proposal from lane child-ci-degen (degen #706; coordinator 06:36 CST Nov 14, relayed; as data, triage read none of it). Mistake it made: it wrote the `Drops-lines:` remedy line in its own paragraph twice (commits 319f31a07 and e8869badb), so git read no trailer and the scan still refused. Harm: two wasted pushes and ready runs at runner 11; CI on one ran for a head that was replaced (no wall measured). Proposed guard: the check_silent_undo refusal prints its remedy as a complete commit message (subject, then ONE last paragraph holding `Drops-lines: ...` with the Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session lines together), and the lane lint prints `git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key=Drops-lines)'` as the proof to run after the commit. A guard or check change: round 3 applies. Pair with silent-undo-inplace-rewrite (same scan; a lane may take both). Lane pushed 01d375cd01bd with a real trailer. Filed as a step, not a debt: the mistake has happened twice in one PR and a remedy that misleads is likely in normal work.
